174: Vincent is an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection. He is an "In-Valid" who assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation.
There is no gene for the human spirit.

Live by the code. Die by the code.

Good times never seemed so good.

This is not war, it's extinction.

See these incredible scenes before your unbelieving eyes!

Get up. Live your day. Get killed. Again.

Greatness comes to those who take it.

No speed limits the next 90 min.

In the heart of a city, an adult nightmare is about to be reborn...

8622: Struggling to elevate himself from his low caste in 17th century Japan, Miyamoto trains to become a mighty samurai warrior.

They gave her looks. Brains. Nuclear capabilities. Everything but an "off" switch.

Never assume anything on the internet matches its profile picture.

John, Count of Luxembourg, Joan's Captor
Georges de la Trémouille, the King's Chief Counsellor
Jean, Duke d'Alencon, cousin of Charles

14254: In a dusty post-war summer in rural Warwickshire, a doctor is called to a patient at lonely Hundreds Hall. Home to the Ayres family for over two centuries, the Georgian house is now in decline. But are the Ayreses haunted by something more sinister than a dying way of life?

Director of the Propaganda Work Team

Who Says That Man Scripts His Own Destiny By Himself?
17838: Three middle aged men polish their martial arts skills to avenge their fallen master.

Newly Rich. Newly Single. Forever Young.

There are a couple of ways to avoid death....one is to be magnificent

What price would you pay for freedom?

Let the battle for high school begin.

His family's future depends on one unstable element.
21166: A man tries to recover a horse stolen from him by a Mexican bandit.
Southwest to Sonora rode the lustful, the lawless... to live on the edge of violence!

The tortured ghost who claims vengeance in the bride's bedroom!
22446: Locals in an Italian village believe evil has taken over the estate of a recently deceased pianist where murder has taken place. The alleged killer: the pianist's severed hand.
Your flesh will creep…at the hand that crawls!
Bruce Conrad [Conrad Ryler in on-screen end credits]

An Inside View of Political Detainees
22958: A melancholic gunfighter is drawn into a vengeful and tragic kidnapping plot by his widowed ex-lover.
Her thirst for revenge made his guns shoot to kill

Deputy National Security Advisor Jake Baerington

But as the night stretches on, Blake begins to behave strangely, transforming into something unrecognizable.
23982: When several children disappear at the hands of a serial killer in Sector 36, a corrupt cop is forced to pursue the chilling case at all costs.

There is no light where we're going.

25262: A robbery leaves a proprietor penniless before his wedding, but becoming a son-in-law to a second family might be the financial solution he needs.
25518: Bimbisara is a ruthless emperor of Trigarthala in 500 BC. Bimbisara has to deal with modern day hustle and bustle.
A time travel from Evil to Good

26286: At 2 Ela lost her ability of seeing and hearing because of a severe illness. And then she became a total disappointment of her family due to her untamed behaviors. But everything changed after an unorthodox teacher stepped into their lives to educate Ela while healing himself.

For the young couple begins a fight for bare survival.
26798: When Ainara announces that she wants to become a nun, chaos arises in her family. Is this a genuine desire or has she been influenced by the religious staff at her school? Or is this life-changing decision due to her father’s inattention and her mother’s absence?
27054: Justice needs to be served at Britain's most notorious young offenders institute.
This summer ... justice will be served
27310: In return for getting ownership his shop space in Mumbai, Prakashan is tempted into helping his landlord's mother on a mission. Will he succeed? What does success mean?
27566: After a young couple moves into a remote farmhouse with their infant son, the woman's struggles with postpartum psychosis begin to intensify... as the house reveals secrets of its own.
In this house, you're never yourself. And never alone.

All is not as it seems as the King family go about their day-to-day lives oblivious of the horror to come. Dad Andy (Bradley Cole) is nursing a secret that ultimately leads to terrible consequences for them all. We witness these chilling events unfold through daughter Judith's video camera, which subsequently becomes Exhibit A.
28334: A young man and his lookalike team up to fight injustice and settle their personal scores with the evildoers.
28846: A senator is targeted by the Pentangle, a right wing paramilitary group. His pal, a former CIA agent and martial artist, tries to help him. The group kidnaps the agent's sister and tries to hunt him down, "The Most Dangerous Game" style.

Thus begins a rampage against the injustices of the system.

A crooked coroner and a corrupt police officer cover up his misdeeds, while Babic grows increasingly dependant on drugs and alcohol. He begins performing illegal abortions on prostitutes who work for Jedinko, a gangster who controls the local drug and sex trade.
32174: Sabit Kanca lives alone and has a mind full of knowledge. He enters a television game show in which he shows off his mental prowess!
32430: Three teenagers skip school in order to explore an abandoned film studio lot where they catch sight of a woman being dragged by a masked man.

Adventure Beyond the Edge of Time

33198: Centered around the 2002 massacres in Gujarat, the film tells the story of a happy family that is torn apart by the loss of their son Parzan.
33454: A mother must protect her family on Christmas Day from a demented stranger who is hell bent on tearing them apart.
This Christmas, the only thing under the tree is terror.

Parton / Alexandre / Francis / Julian / Hokuro / Doctor / Assistant / Mummies / Boss / Subordinate / Other (voice)

34734: Heartbroken that their children no longer want to spend time with them, two parents fake an inheritance to bring the family together for Christmas.

Todd Boomer is embracing his homework like never before!

The Postman and Gardener Who Took on McDonald's, and Won.
